pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are characterized by sub-polygonal geometries with rounded vertices; edge boundaries show soft pixel gradients rather than sharp transitions; spatial area of patches is large relative to the inter-patch spacing on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous network of corridors with predominantly trivalent (3-way) junction nodes; corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the upper flank, widening progressively towards the ventral midline.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck, created by short, upright dark brown fibers forming a jagged 1D contour against the background.
